decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly flood the board with powerful Merfolk creatures and utilize their synergy to control the game. By using cards like Silvergill Adept, Lord of Atlantis, and Master of the Pearl Trident, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption. With cards like Subtlety and Merfolk Trickster providing additional control options, the deck can dictate the pace of the game and gradually wear down the opponent. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for efficient creature deployment, while lands like Mutavault and Cavern of Souls ensure consistent mana production for the deck's strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. The deck also includes cards like Leyline Binding and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats efficiently. Additionally, the deck can generate value and card advantage through cards like Nissa, Resurgent Animist and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The inclusion of creatures like Solitude and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines provides additional defense and threats to close out the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements.

This deck aims to utilize combo pieces such as Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker alongside cards like Indomitable Creativity and Leyline Binding to disrupt opponents and create powerful board states. By combining control elements like Spell Pierce and removal spells with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, the deck seeks to control the game while assembling its combo pieces for a game-winning play. The inclusion of lands like Dwarven Mine and Xander's Lounge provide additional utility and mana-fixing to support the deck's strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, while controlling the board with spells like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce. The deck also includes cards like Persist and Bitter Reunion for additional synergy with the combo strategy. Leyline Binding helps to protect key pieces of the combo, while planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide additional utility and card advantage. The mana base includes a variety of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The primary focus of this deck is to aggressively damage the opponent as quickly as possible by playing cheap and efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, while supporting them with burn spells such as Lightning Bolt, Boros Charm, and Lava Spike. This strategy is aimed at applying constant pressure and preventing the opponent from stabilizing, with cards like Skullcrack and Roiling Vortex disrupting their life gain plan. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, enabling the deck to consistently deal damage and close out games swiftly.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The deck also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Leyline Binding to set up the combo. Teferi, Time Raveler provides disruption while Wrenn and Six help with land recursion. The deck utilizes a mix of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent mana fixing. This combo-centric deck aims to quickly assemble its pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures for a fast victory.

The deck focuses on quickly milling the opponent's library, utilizing cards like Ruin Crab and Hedron Crab to trigger powerful mill effects like Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity. It also includes disruption spells like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to control the board while filling the opponent's graveyard. The goal is to mill the opponent's library as quickly as possible, utilizing powerful mill spells like Tasha's Hideous Laughter to win the game. Jace, the Perfected Mind provides additional milling power and control, while the land base helps to enable the deck's strategy efficiently.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on utilizing cheap, efficient spells to quickly fill the graveyard and power up Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent. With a mix of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and disruptive spells like Counterspell and Unholy Heat, this deck aims to control the board while dealing consistent damage. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Thought Scour helps to keep the momentum going by enabling card draw and graveyard filling. The mana base is designed for flexibility and consistency, allowing for quick access to the necessary colors of mana.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. By controlling the board with cards like Leyline Binding, Lightning Bolt, and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Wrenn and Six allows for flexibility and card advantage, while cards such as Prismatic Ending and Spell Pierce provide additional utility. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's combo potential and ensure consistency in executing its strategy.

Utilizing powerful creatures and spells to disrupt opponents while generating value and creating explosive combos through cards such as Archon of Cruelty, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Indomitable Creativity. By controlling the board with cards like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce, while also utilizing Leyline Binding to lock down key cards, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with unexpected plays and high synergy interactions. With strong mana fixing and versatile cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, this deck offers a unique and dynamic playstyle that rewards strategic planning and creativity.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to create a powerful board presence, usually with Archon of Cruelty or Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, while keeping opponents in check with counterspells like Spell Pierce and removal like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending. Leyline Binding provides additional control to the board state. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six offer flexibility and card advantage. The mana base includes fetchlands for consistency and utility lands for additional options. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble a game-winning combo using its creative and versatile card choices.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the powerful combo of Indomitable Creativity and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to cheat out high-cost creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Titan of Industry early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board while setting up for the combo. The inclusion of cards like Persist and Bitter Reunion adds resilience and card advantage to the deck. Overall, the deck focuses on creative combos and strong creature plays to quickly take control of the game.

The deck focuses on using Primeval Titan to search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and fetch lands that can trigger its ability. By combining Indomitable Creativity and Leyline Binding to manipulate the top of the library, the deck can cheat out powerful creatures like Wrenn and Six, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck aims to be creative in its combo plays while utilizing a variety of spells like Lightning Bolt, Remand, and Prismari Command for control and removal.

The deck aims to control the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and creature abilities to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents. With a strong focus on powerful Elemental creatures and planeswalkers such as Omnath, Locus of Creation and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck seeks to establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By efficiently managing resources and answering threats, the deck looks to grind out victories through incremental advantages and overwhelming the opponent with its versatile and resilient threats.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the powerful combo of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to equip a creature with massive amounts of damage. The deck also utilizes efficient creatures like Esper Sentinel and Stoneforge Mystic to control the board and search for key pieces. With cards like Urza's Saga and Sigarda's Aid to support the equipment strategy, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and deadly attack. The inclusion of Inkmoth Nexus provides an alternate win condition through infect damage.

This deck focuses on using counters and +1/+1 effects to quickly grow and overwhelm creatures, creating a powerful aggressive strategy. By playing cards like Hardened Scales, Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp and The Ozolith, the deck can rapidly increase the power of its creatures and snowball out of control. Additionally, the deck utilizes Arcbound Ravager and Hangarback Walker as key threats that can quickly close out games. Overall, the goal is to build a board state that is difficult for the opponent to deal with and win through combat damage.
